Católica]] were the defending champions. ==Teams== 16 teams took part in the league in this season, down by one from the previous season: the top 14 teams from the [[2021 Chilean Primera División|2021 tournament]], plus the [[2021 Primera B de Chile|2021 Primera B]] champions [[Coquimbo Unido]] and the winners of the [[2021 Chilean Primera División#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]] [[C.D. Huachipato|Huachipato]].
